summary: The macOS launch splash could remain indefinitely if a pre-session initialization step stalled. One 20-second deadline now covers API/session storage initialization, platform initialization, current-session lookup, and account preparation, with a retryable connection error on timeout.

checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/app_state_test.dart --plain-name 'a stalled session-storage bootstrap exits loading'
checks.observation: Before extending the deadline, a stalled API/session-storage initialization left AppPhase.loading instead of transitioning to AppPhase.connectionError.

checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/app_state_test.dart --plain-name 'a stalled account-preparation bootstrap exits loading'
checks.observation: Before moving account preparation under the deadline, a stalled native preference read left AppPhase.loading instead of transitioning to AppPhase.connectionError.
All four startup stalls (API initialization, native notification initialization, session check, and account preparation) produce a retryable connection error.
The macOS Debug app built successfully.

Before the fix, UI inspection of the running macOS app showed 'Подключаемся к гильдии…'. The exact blocking native/network operation was not sampled. Relaunch the current-source macOS app, confirm the timeout reaches the retry screen and retry succeeds with the real Keychain/session; check a signed Release separately.
